summary: Lines drawn under, over or through text.
details: Shorthand for the line, its style, colour and thickness. Links are underlined by default; text-underline-offset moves the underline away from the letters.

values.note: Remove the underline (e.g. on nav links).
Dotted underline, often used for abbreviations.
Strike through, e.g. an old price.

gotcha: Removing the underline from links in body text makes them hard to spot. If you do, give links another clear signal such as colour plus weight.
